exact_tokens: Export flows across storage-plan.md, usage-feature.md, Runtime_Artifacts_Panel.md, and FinalGUISpec.md all lack a shared identity-preserving manifest discipline
Exported bundles must carry identity-preserving manifests that reference canonical IDs (project_id, attempt_id, run_id, thread_id) rather than reconstructed or opaque identifiers
notes: Export bundles must include a manifest with canonical IDs. Currently no doc owns the export manifest discipline; storage-plan.md is the natural owner.
